note: Limited-time events, read off Kuro's own EN posts: the per-patch Content Overview for the list, dates and flavour, and each event's own notice for its banner art, screenshots and rewards. Art is hotlinked from Kuro's CDN, never rehosted. `media` is the notice's other pictures where they are landscape — a screenshot of the mode, not the post set as a poster. An event with no notice yet has no art by design. Times carry +08:00 because Kuro publishes them in server time.

events.name: If Dreams Still Reverberate
events.summary: Fourteen stages, seven surface and seven deep, all playable in co-op.
events.detail: This event consists of 14 stages, 7 Surface Layer stages and 7 Deep Layer stages. The stages unlock gradually: clear each Surface Layer stage to unlock the corresponding Deep Layer stage, and clear all Surface Layer stages to unlock the Abyss of the Final Dreams for a boss-rush challenge. In this challenge, you can choose "Dorothy's Companions" as Echoes to assist you in battle, which greatly enhances the combat abilities of Resonators. As you progress through the stages, you encounter a growing variety of enemies and can deploy more and more Support Echoes. All stages can be completed in Co-Op Mode with other Rovers.
